entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-05-11
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Make `arcade` use `dotnetup` #54258
  • Make `dotnet sdk` branch use `dotnetup` #54257
  • Create documentation for internal preview release #54256
  • Create install scripts that use GitHub Releases #54255
  • Create process to release dotnetup via GitHub Releases #54254
  • dotnet-format unit tests were not running in CI — 3 pre-existing failures discovered #54249
  • macOS arm64 Helix payload includes x86_64-only Microsoft.NETCore.App/10.0.0 #54248

Closed

  • Testhost runtimeconfig is missing for .NET10 #53412
  • `dotnet tool install` fails in a directory with .proj files #12120
    Backlog
  • CA1033 should not report errors for interfaces #50341
  • `dotnet tool install --global {1}` in `CannotFindCommandAvailableAsTool` should not be translated #10299
    Backlog

PullRequests

Created

  • Fix arm64 macOS CI installing x64 runtimes under Rosetta 2 #54253
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Add exclusion pattern support to `--test-modules` glob expressions #54252
  • File-based apps: handle conversion of custom included item types #54251
    Area-run-file
  • Trim whitespace in MTP `--test-modules` expressions #54250
  • Bump Microsoft.DotNet.Helix.Sdk from 11.0.0-beta.26208.110 to 11.0.0-beta.26258.110 #54246
    Area-Infrastructure, dependencies, dependabot: main
  • Bump Microsoft.DotNet.Arcade.Sdk from 11.0.0-beta.26208.110 to 11.0.0-beta.26258.110 #54245
    Area-Infrastructure, dependencies, dependabot: main

Merged

  • Fix the internal 8.0 builds to correctly use the internal feeds to install the workloads #54242
  • Add COPILOT_CLI env var to LLM environment detection #54227
  • Fix xUnit1051 build errors in CA1033 tests #54247
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Avoid reporting CA1033 for interfaces #50339
    Area-Infrastructure, Area-Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.NetAnalyzers
  • Allow explicitly skipping crossgen #54094

Updated

  • dotnetup daily builds (Phase 1): blob feed fallback for fully-specified prerelease versions #54224
  • dotnet tool update: include existing version in update messages and remove dead code #54192
  • Fix NETSDK1187: Replace OS-dependent CultureInfo locale normalization with platform-independent BCP 47 algorithm #53817
  • Delete unused resources from CliCommandStrings #53858
  • Fix unhandled ObjectDisposedException in TimestampedFileLogger during workload repair #54097
  • Properly ingest `dotnetup` data after `data-x-migration` #54051
  • Use templating for NetAnalyzers SARIF SDK version #54027
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Convert dotnet-format integration tests from pipeline YAML to XUnit/Helix #54231
  • Validate realm returned in the container auth handshake #54225
    Document for new feature, Area-Containers
  • Add end-to-end tests for Compatibility tooling and use Runtime=NET for apicompat and genapi tasks #54205
    Area-ApiCompat
  • Add 'mcpserver' project template as bundled template #54132
    Area-Templates
  • Allow some duplicate #: directives #54206
    Area-run-file
  • CA2028: Avoid redundant Regex.IsMatch before Regex.Match #54071
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Add explicit migration support to dotnetup install #53909
  • Use MSBuild CommandLineParser for terminal logger detection #53835
    Area-CLI
